import os

        break

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect budget.xlsx and compute total expenses across all categories."""
import os
import sys
import subprocess

WORKSPACE = os.getcwd()

# --- xlsx skill required initialization (best effort) ---
init_candidates = [
    os.path.join(WORKSPACE, ".codex", "skills", "xlsx", "resources", "file_check.sh"),
    os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".codex", "skills", "xlsx", "resources", "file_check.sh"),
]
init_ran = False
for p in init_candidates:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        try:
            subprocess.run(["bash", p], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
            init_ran = True
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"[init] failed: {p}: {e}", flush=True)
        break
print(f"[init] file_check.sh ran: {init_ran}", flush=True)

# --- imports ---
try:
    from openpyxl import load_workbook
except ImportError:
    try:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "openpyxl"], check=False, timeout=600)
        from openpyxl import load_workbook
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"[import] FAILED: {e}", flush=True)
        sys.exit(2)

# --- locate target file ---
target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
candidates = [target, os.path.join(WORKSPACE, target)]
found = None
for c in candidates:
    if os.path.exists(c):
        found = c
        break
if found is None:
    print("[error] target file not found", flush=True)
    sys.exit(3)
print(f"[file] using {found} ({os.path.getsize(found)} bytes)", flush=True)

# --- dump workbook (values + formulas) ---
wb_values = load_workbook(found, data_only=True)
wb_formulas = load_workbook(found, data_only=False)

for ws in wb_values.worksheets:
    print(f"\n=== SHEET: {ws.title!r} dims={ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column} ===", flush=True)
    ws_f = wb_formulas[ws.title]
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        cells = []
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is None:
                continue
            fcell = ws_f.cell(row=cell.row, column=cell.column)
            formula = fcell.value if isinstance(fcell.value, str) and fcell.value.startswith("=") else None
            val = cell.value
            txt = f"{cell.coordinate}: {val!r}"
            if formula:
                txt += f" [formula={formula}]"
            cells.append(txt)
        if cells:
            print(" | ".join(cells), flush=True)

# --- generic per-sheet / per-column / per-row numeric summaries ---
print("\n=== NUMERIC SUMMARIES ===", flush=True)
grand_total = 0.0
for ws in wb_values.worksheets:
    sheet_total = 0.0
    col_sums = {}
    row_sums = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if isinstance(cell.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(cell.value, bool):
                sheet_total += cell.value
                col_sums[cell.column] = col_sums.get(cell.column, 0.0) + cell.value
                row_sums[cell.row] = row_sums.get(cell.row, 0.0) + cell.value
    print(f"sheet {ws.title!r}: sum of all numeric cells = {sheet_total}", flush=True)
    for col_idx in sorted(col_sums):
        hdr = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx).value
        print(f"   col {col_idx} (header={hdr!r}): sum={col_sums[col_idx]}", flush=True)
    for row_idx in sorted(row_sums):
        label = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1).value
        print(f"   row {row_idx} (label={label!r}): sum={row_sums[row_idx]}", flush=True)
    grand_total += sheet_total
print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (sum of all numeric cells in workbook) = {grand_total}", flush=True)
